literal: To those who have renounced, provisions desiring, forgot-they I-wonder, other people, penance.
translation: I wonder if other people have forgotten penance because they desire to provide for those who have renounced.
modern: துறவிகளுக்கு உணவு முதலியவற்றை அளிக்க விரும்பித்தான் மற்றவர்கள் தவம் செய்வதை மறந்துவிட்டார்களோ?
explanation: The couplet playfully wonders why everyone does not practice asceticism. It suggests that 'other people' (householders) have forgotten to do penance only because they are busy providing 'provisions' (துப்புரவு) to those who have already renounced the world. The particle 'கொல்' adds a tone of gentle wonder or rhetorical questioning. Thus, it highlights the necessary and complementary role of householders in supporting ascetics.
